agents.role: Main agent — the default contact; routes anything cross-project.
Western Heart game lane (roster, banks, builds, republish).
Cape Jones animated series lane (scenes, dance, renders).
Ops contact: disk guardian, overnight pipeline, watchdogs. Mostly agent-initiated alerts; replies route to the ops lane.

comment: Agent contact registry. Copy to agents.json and fill numberEnv values via environment/secrets at deploy time. 'number' here is a PLACEHOLDER for local/mock runs only — production numbers are read from the env var named by numberEnv, never committed. Each agent = one number = one contact on the owner's phone. backend.url may contain {agentId}; when backend.type is 'stub', the built-in stub backend answers (local dev/tests).
